metadata.description: Prototype iGOT Karmayogi course catalogue. Replace with authorized iGOT API in production.
metadata.disclaimer: This is simulated data for SIH prototype demonstration only.

courses.title: Python Fundamentals for Government Data
courses.description: Introduction to Python programming covering syntax, data types, control flow and functions. Designed for government statistical officers.

courses.title: Python for Data Analysis
courses.description: Learn Python pandas and NumPy for data wrangling, cleaning, and exploratory analysis on government datasets.

courses.title: Advanced Python: Statistical Computing
courses.description: Advanced Python with scipy, statsmodels, and sklearn for statistical inference, modeling, and prediction.

courses.title: Foundations of Statistics
courses.description: Core concepts of descriptive statistics, probability, normal distribution, and basic inference for official data analysis.

courses.title: Statistical Inference & Hypothesis Testing
courses.description: Parametric and non-parametric tests, confidence intervals, and ANOVA for government survey data interpretation.

courses.title: Advanced Statistical Modeling
courses.description: Regression models, time-series analysis, ARIMA forecasting, and Bayesian methods for national statistics.

courses.title: Introduction to Data Analysis
courses.description: Understand data pipelines, exploratory data analysis, and summary statistics for administrative datasets.

courses.title: Data Analysis for Policy Decisions
courses.description: Apply data analysis techniques to real government policy datasets. Covering trends, outliers, and comparative analysis.

courses.title: Advanced Data Analytics & Predictive Models
courses.description: Build predictive models and perform advanced analytical workflows using real-world government microdata.

courses.title: Machine Learning Essentials
courses.description: Supervised and unsupervised learning fundamentals: linear regression, decision trees, k-means, applied to government data.

courses.title: Applied Machine Learning for Statistics
courses.description: Apply ML algorithms (random forests, SVM, gradient boosting) to classification and regression tasks in official statistics.

courses.title: Deep Learning & NLP for Government Data
courses.description: Neural networks, transformers, and NLP applied to unstructured government text data and large-scale pattern recognition.

courses.title: SQL for Government Databases
courses.description: Write SQL queries to extract, filter, join, and summarize data from official government relational databases.

courses.title: Advanced SQL & Database Optimization
courses.description: Window functions, CTEs, stored procedures, and performance tuning for large government administrative databases.

courses.title: Data Warehousing & BI with SQL
courses.description: Design star schemas, build ETL pipelines, and create business intelligence reports using SQL in government IT systems.

courses.title: Effective Government Communication
courses.description: Write clear official correspondence, memos, and reports. Develop presentation and public speaking skills for civil servants.

courses.title: Strategic Communication for Policy Officers
courses.description: Master stakeholder communication, briefing notes, data-driven storytelling, and cross-departmental coordination.

courses.title: Executive Communication & Leadership Presence
courses.description: Advanced communication for senior officers: crisis communication, media interaction, and high-stakes presentations.

courses.title: Foundations of Leadership in Public Service
courses.description: Core leadership competencies for government officers: motivation, team building, decision-making under constraints.

courses.title: People Management & Team Leadership
courses.description: Lead diverse teams, manage performance, resolve conflict, and build a culture of accountability in government organizations.

courses.title: Strategic Leadership & Change Management
courses.description: Drive transformation programs, manage resistance, and align departments with national mission objectives.

courses.title: Data Visualization Fundamentals
courses.description: Create charts, graphs, and maps to communicate government data clearly. Covers chart selection, colors, and accessibility.

courses.title: Dashboard Design for Government Reports
courses.description: Build interactive KPI dashboards using real administrative data. Covers Tableau, Power BI, and Python matplotlib/seaborn.

courses.title: Advanced Data Visualization & Geospatial Mapping
courses.description: Build advanced geospatial visualizations, animated charts, and real-time data dashboards for national scheme monitoring.
